verdict.rationale: Runloop is sandbox infrastructure for running your own or third-party agents: Devboxes, the Agents API, agent mounts, the OpenCode tutorials, and Cursor rules files that give your external AI assistant context. Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party AI assistant built into the dashboard, CLI, or platform that a user can hand tasks to. Hosting agents you bring yourself is a different capability, so this applicable story is unevidenced.
